payload.title: 4. Give the two homepage banners distinct wording
payload.description:
Give the homepage's two horizontal loop bands their agreed, distinct phrases.

Tasks:
- First horizontal band: "Information About Information Systems".
- Second horizontal band: "Machines on Machines".
- Repeat only the assigned phrase within each band as needed to fill the continuous loop. Uppercase styling may follow the existing design.
- Pass the phrases through the existing page/block/component path as needed, instead of changing every band on the site globally.
- Preserve the existing scroll-linked motion, opposite directions and reduced-motion presentation.
- Keep topic/hashtag bands on section pages working as before and keep essential introductory information in the stationary text outside the decorative bands.
- Sync the reference component and published assets if this implementation changes them.

Likely surfaces: the two loop-band includes in web/pages/home.md, the loop-band block in web/hooks.py, and the existing LoopBand components/styles where necessary.

Complete when the two homepage bands display exactly their assigned wording and retain a continuous appearance across desktop and mobile. Do not add slogans, random phrase selection, additional bands or a new animation system.
